question: The mean proportional between 9 + 3sqrt{7} and 18 - 6sqrt{7}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional between **a** and **b** is √(a × b).

Product = (9 + 3√7) × (18 − 6√7) = (9 + 3√7) × 2(9 − 3√7).

Using (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y² ⇒ 2 × (9² − (3√7)²) = 2 × (81 − 63) = 2 × 18 = 36.

Mean proportional = √36 = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** First value (a) = 9 + 3√7, Second value (b) = 18 − 6√7.

**Formula Used:** Mean Proportional (M.P.) = √(a × b)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc5c1230e160532621bb68c44e47b4948a748d2b92b51d38770064cfb2f56ad3.png] 

⇒ M.P. = √[(9 + 3√7) × (18 − 6√7)]

⇒ M.P. = √[(9 + 3√7) × 6(3 − √7)]

⇒ M.P. = √[3(3 + √7) × 6(3 − √7)]

⇒ M.P. = √[18 × (3² − (√7)²)]

⇒ M.P. = √[18 × (9 − 7)]

⇒ M.P. = √[18 × 2]

⇒ M.P. = √36

⇒ M.P. = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

For two numbers a and b, the third proportional is calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional d satisfies the ratio a:b = c:d, so d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Mean Proportional Concept

If x is the mean proportional between a and b, then a:x = x:b, which results in x² = ab.</p
